name: Ulysse Nardin Marine Chronometer Annual Calendar 43mm
description: The Ulysse Nardin Marine Chronometer Annual Calendar combines nautical inspiration with precise mechanics. It features an annual calendar complication, requiring adjustment only once a year, and is powered by the in-house UN-113 movement. With a classic marine chronometer design, it includes a power reserve indicator, small seconds at 6 o'clock, and a large date display. Its 43mm case is available in stainless steel or rose gold, maintaining the brand's heritage of creating robust, maritime-inspired timepieces.
